_readme: The guest push catalogue for open matches (build contracts §1.9, R3; docs/design/open-matches/guest.md §4.7). ONE list for three copies: send-push (a guest kind reads its copy by title_key from send-push/guestStrings.ts, and a row whose kind is not its title key's kind, or whose route is not listed here, is terminal), app.match_notify (c_keys, 0261; packages/db/tests/guest-push.test.ts compares), and apps/mobile/src/features/matches/pushRoutes.ts (routes). title_keys maps each key to the one kind it is queued under. Params are closed to the three names below: no name and no amount ever reaches a lock screen. Deno cannot import a workspace package, so this JSON is the shared artefact, as staff-push.json is. Add a key here, in guestStrings.ts (EN and AR) and in app.match_notify in the same change, and deploy send-push before a migration can queue it.
